name: Paneer Butter Masala
description: Rich, creamy curry with soft paneer cubes in a spiced tomato-cashew gravy. A North Indian classic.

name: Veg Biryani
description: Aromatic long-grain basmati rice layered with seasonal vegetables, saffron, and whole spices.

name: Chicken Curry
description: Tender chicken pieces slow-cooked in a deeply spiced onion-tomato masala. Pairs perfectly with naan.

name: Vegan Tofu Salad
description: Fresh garden greens topped with golden pan-seared tofu and a zesty lemon vinaigrette.

name: Cheese Garlic Bread
description: Oven-toasted artisan bread smothered in garlic herb butter and melted mozzarella. Irresistible starter.

name: Spicy Chicken Wings
description: Crispy double-fried wings tossed in a house-made sriracha-honey glaze. Dangerously addictive.

name: Gluten-Free Margherita Pizza
description: Stone-baked on a crispy gluten-free base with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil.

name: Vegan Sushi Roll
description: Inside-out roll filled with creamy avocado, crunchy cucumber, and tangy pickled daikon.

name: Grilled Chicken Steak
description: Juicy grilled chicken breast marinated in herbs, served with roasted vegetables and peppercorn sauce.

name: Mango Protein Smoothie
description: Thick, refreshing blend of Alphonso mango, banana, almond milk and plant protein powder.

name: Fish and Chips
description: Golden beer-battered fish fillet with thick-cut chips, mushy peas, and homemade tartar sauce.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Slow-stirred Arborio rice with a medley of wild mushrooms, white wine and aged parmesan.

name: Red Lentil Soup
description: Warming bowl of red lentils slow-cooked with carrots, cumin, turmeric and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Thai Green Curry
description: Fragrant coconut-milk curry with bamboo shoots, Thai basil, and seasonal vegetables. Authentically spicy.

name: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Warm dark-chocolate cake with a molten liquid centre, served with vanilla bean ice cream.
